name: RIPPLE
summary:
# Join our Discord at [https://discord.gg/ripple] for updates, events and giveaways!

Don't touch the water. Something blind lives in the poolrooms, and it hunts by sound. Sneak, climb and escape with your friends!

# Features at a Glance:

**Stay out of the water** - It can't see you, but every splash tells it exactly where you are.
